correctness.rationale: For the exact listed 24-edge Chvatal graph, independently enumerated all 2835 nonempty ordinary matchings (graph edges as simplex vertices), checked all 10816 nonempty Hasse incidences for a 1396-pair acyclic Morse matching with critical cell counts 1 vertex, 35 3-cells, seven 4-cells. Independently reconstructed the signed integer Morse 35x7 boundary and its Smith factors (1^6,3), implying 28 free S^3 and one M(Z/3,3) by first nonzero homotopy group and elementary cell cancellation. Package references a root verify_chvatal.py and verification_output.txt that could not be fetched at those paths: this is an explicit reproducibility/source-enumeration risk, not a reason to pretend the independent calculation failed.

value.rationale: The Chvatal graph is a canonical smallest triangle-free four-chromatic regular graph; its exact integral matching-complex Moore torsion and free multiplicity give a motivated graph-specific counterexample to naive sphere-wedge expectations and a natural comparison to known planar examples.
